posts.text:
A Toledo Bend lake note for November 5, for neighbors planning time on the water.

The Texas Water Development Board's 8:45 AM reading puts the lake at 167.74 feet—about 4.3 feet below its 172-foot conservation pool. That reading is provisional, so check the current level and your chosen launch before heading out.

TPWD's regular weekly fishing reports are still on hold. This week's note sticks to the lake level rather than guessing at a lakewide bite or recommending a lure from an old report.

Bass, crappie or catfish—which one is on your list for the next trip?

Current lake data: https://waterdatafortexas.org/reservoirs/individual/toledo-bend
Report availability: https://tpwd.texas.gov/fishboat/fish/action/reptform2.php?lake=TOLEDO+BEND&yearcat=current&archive=latest&Submit=Go
